hints.message: ROUTING HINT: This likely needs `/app-arch-required` and an ADR check.

ROUTING HINT: To verify an app/game against attacks or run the security check, use the nrg-shield-red-team skill (runner: app_entry_root/packages/nrg-shield/tools/attack-battery.sh, table: app_entry_root/packages/nrg-shield/docs/SECURITY-CHECK.md).

ROUTING HINT: To measure an app size (download per phone, bundle, APK parts, budget), use the app-size skill (runner: node scripts/app-size.js --project <android project> --variant <variant> [--build] [--warn MB --max MB]).

ROUTING HINT: For anything Google Play Games on PC (PC build, release, labels Playable/Optimized, PC store card, developer emulator, label form) use the play-games-pc skill: every Google requirement item by item (required AND recommended), check the MERGED manifest of the shipped build, release first, then the form with both package fields.

ROUTING HINT: For screenshots/frames use the app-screenshots skill: build `assemblePlayCapture` (non-debuggable, AOT on install), `tools/device.py install`, then `tools/capture.py` (default in-app grab, ~0.5 s/frame); retake only wrong frames with --force --why, read the lint and every frame, parity gate for engine changes.
